question: _________ defeated the Indian Railway 3 - 0, to win the men’s title at the Senior National Volleyball Championship 2021-22.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Haryana **defeated the Indian Railway 3 - 0, to win the men’s title at the Senior National Volleyball Championship 2021-22.
 
• **In the women’s category,** the Kerala team defeated the** Indian Railway 3-1, to lift the trophy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **69th** Senior National Volleyball Championship 2020-21 was inaugurated at the Biju Patnaik Indoor Stadium, KIIT Deemed to be University on March 5, 2021.
 
• For the first time in the history of Indian volleyball, Odisha as a state hosted the senior national championship for the second time.
 
• Also for the first time, all the matches would be played on Indoor courts with live streaming.
